2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes, Nix Return in High-Stakes AFC West Opener
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: The Denver Broncos and Kansas City Chiefs clash on Monday Night Football, with both Patrick Mahomes and Bo Nix returning from injuries. The Chiefs' pass protection, which struggled last season, faces a stiff test against the Broncos' pass rush. Denver's defense, led by Vance Joseph, has historically given Mahomes fits. Meanwhile, Nix must navigate a rebuilt Chiefs secondary. The teams' early-down approaches and play-action strategies will also be crucial.

Its frozen F-ST engine reconciles a 31.6% football-only signal with a 54.3% vig-free market signal under the 2026 production specification; it is not a fixed arithmetic blend. That official probability translates to a probability-implied presentation line of Kansas City Chiefs -2.3, a market line of Kansas City Chiefs -2.5, and an approximate coherent score of KC 24 – DEN 22. Chiefs' protection against Broncos' pressure determines whether Chiefs can stay on schedule; if Chiefs holds up, Broncos' cleanest disruption path narrows. The pick: Kansas City Chiefs moneyline.
